cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# _test_cmake — generated by Hardware2Code
# MCU: STM32G0B1RET6 ()
# Core Clock: 64 MHz
# FreeRTOS Kernel: included from static
# Build: cmake -B build -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=toolchain.cmake && cmake --build build
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

project(_test_cmake C ASM)

# ── MCU compile definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_compile_definitions(
    STM32G0B1RET6
    STM32G0B1xx
    USE_HAL_DRIVER
    HSE_VALUE=$<IF:$<BOOL:8000000>,8000000,8000000>
    HCLK_FREQ=$<IF:$<BOOL:64000000>,64000000,64000000>
)

# ── Static library path (HAL + CMSIS + FreeRTOS + Unity) ────────────────────
set(HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC "$ENV{HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC}" CACHE PATH
    "Path to hw2c static/ directory")
if(NOT HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC)
    set(HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC "C:/Users/pc/Documents/hw2c/static/stm32g0")
endif()

set(HAL_DIR           "${HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC}/HAL")
set(CMSIS_DEVICE_DIR  "${HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC}/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32G0xx")
set(CMSIS_CORE_DIR    "${HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC}/CMSIS/Core")
set(STARTUP_DIR       "${CMSIS_DEVICE_DIR}/Source/Templates/gcc")
set(FREERTOS_DIR      "${HARDWARE2CODE_STATIC}/FreeRTOS-Kernel")

# ── Linker script ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(LINKER_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/linker/STM32G0B1RETx_FLASH.ld")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -T${LINKER_SCRIPT}")

# ── Global include directories ──────────────────────────────────────────────
set(COMMON_INCLUDES
    ${HAL_DIR}/Inc
    ${CMSIS_DEVICE_DIR}/Include
    ${CMSIS_CORE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/config
)
list(APPEND COMMON_INCLUDES
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/include
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/GCC/ARM_CM0
)

# ── HAL library (object library, shared) ─────────────────────────────────────
add_library(hal OBJECT
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_cortex.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_gpio.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_rcc.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_rcc_ex.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_pwr.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_pwr_ex.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_exti.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_tim.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_tim_ex.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_uart.c
    ${HAL_DIR}/Src/stm32g0xx_hal_uart_ex.c
    ${CMSIS_DEVICE_DIR}/Source/Templates/system_stm32g0xx.c
    ${STARTUP_DIR}/startup_stm32g0b1xx.s
)
target_include_directories(hal PRIVATE ${COMMON_INCLUDES})
target_compile_options(hal PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}>
    -Og -g3
)

# ── FreeRTOS library ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_library(freertos OBJECT
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/tasks.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/queue.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/list.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/timers.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/event_groups.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/stream_buffer.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/GCC/ARM_CM0/port.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/GCC/ARM_CM0/portasm.c
)
target_include_directories(freertos PRIVATE ${COMMON_INCLUDES})

# ── User application executable ──────────────────────────────────────────────
set(APP_SOURCES
    src/main.c
    src/gpio.c
    src/sleep.c
    src/stm32g0xx_it.c
    src/event_mgr.c
    src/stm32g0xx_hal_timebase_tim.c
    src/drivers/drv_log.c
)

# Per-driver includes (each driver may need its own headers)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} ${APP_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${COMMON_INCLUDES}
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/drivers
)

# Link HAL + FreeRTOS to main executable
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE hal freertos)

# Disable linking step try-compile (bare-metal)
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
    SUFFIX ".elf"
    LINK_DEPENDS ${LINKER_SCRIPT}
)

# ── Post-build: generate .bin and .hex ──────────────────────────────────────
add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}>
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.bin
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}>
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.hex
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE_UTIL} $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}>
    COMMENT "Generating .bin and .hex..."
)

# ── Flash targets ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STM32_Programmer_CLI (ST-Link) — set STM32_PROG_CLI in env or cmake cache
set(STM32_PROG_CLI "$ENV{STM32_PROG_CLI}" CACHE FILEPATH "Path to STM32_Programmer_CLI")
if(NOT STM32_PROG_CLI)
    find_program(STM32_PROG_CLI STM32_Programmer_CLI)
endif()

add_custom_target(flash
    COMMAND "${STM32_PROG_CLI}" -c port=SWD -w ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.bin 0x08000000 -rst
    DEPENDS ${PROJECT_NAME}
    COMMENT "Flashing ${PROJECT_NAME}.bin via STM32_Programmer_CLI"
)

# OpenOCD / DAP-Link flash
add_custom_target(flash-daplink
    COMMAND openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/stm32g0x.cfg
            -c "program ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.bin 0x08000000 verify reset exit"
    DEPENDS ${PROJECT_NAME}
    COMMENT "Flashing via OpenOCD (CMSIS-DAP)"
)


# ── Unit tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_custom_target(test
    COMMAND python test/run_tests.py
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    COMMENT "Running unit tests..."
)

add_custom_target(coverage
    COMMAND python test/run_tests.py --coverage
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    COMMENT "Running unit tests with coverage..."
)


# ── Clean helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set_directory_properties(PROPERTIES
    ADDITIONAL_CLEAN_FILES "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/*.bin;${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/*.hex;${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/*.map"
)
